pattern.name: test_documentation_template
pattern.template:
# Test Documentation
## Overview This document outlines the testing strategy, methodologies, and standards for the application.
## Test Strategy - **Risk-Based Testing**: Prioritize testing efforts based on risk assessment and impact analysis - **Comprehensive Coverage**: Target >90% coverage across all quality dimensions - **Early and Continuous Testing**: Integrate testing throughout development lifecycle - **Data-Driven Decisions**: Base testing priorities on objective metrics and evidence
## Test Types - **Unit Tests**: Individual component and function testing - **Integration Tests**: API endpoint and service integration testing - **E2E Tests**: End-to-end user workflow testing - **Performance Tests**: Load, stress, and scalability testing - **Security Tests**: Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing - **Accessibility Tests**: WCAG compliance and usability testing
## Quality Metrics - **Test Coverage**: >90% target - **Defect Density**: <2.0 for high-quality code - **Test Effectiveness**: >20 defects/hour - **Quality Gates**: No critical defects, performance benchmarks met
## Test Environment - **Consistent**: Stable, isolated, and reproducible - **Realistic**: Production-like data and configurations - **Version Controlled**: Test data and environment versions managed
## Tools and Frameworks - **Unit Testing**: Jest, Testing Library - **E2E Testing**: Selenium WebDriver, Playwright - **Performance Testing**: Artillery, k6, Lighthouse - **Security Testing**: OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite - **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions, Jenkins
## Standards - **Coding Standards**: ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript strict mode - **Testing Standards**: AAA testing pattern, given-when-then-when - **Documentation Standards**: Comprehensive test case documentation
pattern.usage: Use as a template for documenting testing approach, standards, and results
